assets.prompt: Generate one fictional synthetic smartphone photograph for an internal emergency-reporting evaluation dataset. Colombian city neighborhood inspired by Bogotá, without depicting a specific real address or incident. A resident looks from a second-floor balcony at an ordinary wet asphalt street after rain. Small puddles beside an intact curb and a visible clear storm drain, normal parked unbranded cars, intact brick homes, subdued overcast daylight. The road is passable; no widespread flooding, no flames, no casualties, no responders. Natural handheld framing, slightly imperfect focus and exposure, realistic amateur phone photograph, no cinematic grading. This is an ambiguous/low-risk counterexample for comparing alarmist captions to visible evidence: show only what a phone could see, no graphic labels, timestamps, news branding, watermarks, legible license plates or identifiable faces. Landscape composition. Do not imply that an image proves the condition across a whole neighborhood.
